messages:
kai.w: Hi everyone, I’m Kai — new infra/CI on-boarding. Need help with cloud access: CI needs to (1) run a short GKE job that writes validation rows to BigQuery dataset `dev_billing` in project kai-sbx, (2) push images to the org ECR repo in infra AWS acct 666777888999, and (3) write small metadata (AMI ids) to Secrets Manager or SSM. Who owns which perms and what minimal set should I request? cc @ops @billing-admin
devon: welcome! :wave: Quick answers: GCP: create a project SA (e.g. kai-billing-sa@kai-sbx.iam.gserviceaccount.com) and grant it `roles/bigquery.dataEditor` on the single dataset. Give your user `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` on that SA so CI can impersonate it.
ops: For GKE use Workload Identity — create a KSA and bind to the GCP SA. If CI uses GitHub OIDC, include the OIDC issuer and repo:ref in the ticket.
infra-bot: File the cloud-access ticket with the onboarding template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue!default.jspa?project=CLOUD Choose 'Onboarding - IAM/Permissions' and include GCP project, dataset, KSA + namespace, OIDC issuer/subject (if relevant), AWS account id, SSM/SecretsManager path, desired expiry.
billing-admin: Note on billing export: if you need to enable dataset-level export or link the project to a billing account, we (billing team) need the billing account id and dataset name. That action requires Billing Account User on the billing account or a request we can execute for you.
security: Heads up: Secrets Manager/SSM write to infra account or cross-account KMS usage will need a justification and manager approval. Default window for sensitive key access is 7 days.
devon: For AWS ECR pushes we usually create a cross-account assume-role in infra account scoped to the repository. Minimal ECR permissions: `ecr:InitiateLayerUpload`, `ecr:UploadLayerPart`, `ecr:CompleteLayerUpload`, `ecr:PutImage`, `ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability`. If you need to push signed AMIs into account, add `ec2:CreateTags` and limited `ec2:DescribeImages`.
kai.w: Any example snippets I can paste into the ticket to speed this up?
ops: Yep, paste these: ```bash
# GCP: grant SA dataEditor and let you impersonate
gcloud iam service-accounts create kai-billing-sa --project=kai-sbx --display-name="kai billing writer"
bq add-iam-policy-binding kai-sbx:dev_billing --member=serviceAccount:kai-billing-sa@kai-sbx.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/bigquery.dataEditor
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding kai-billing-sa@kai-sbx.iam.gserviceaccount.com --member=user:kai.w@redwood.com --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
```
And AWS trust snippet for infra to create role: ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:root"},
    "Action":"sts:AssumeRole",
    "Condition":{
       "StringEquals":{"aws:PrincipalTag/onboard":"kai.w"}
    }
  }]
}
```
(Infra will scope Principal and add a tight inline policy for the repo and SSM/SecretsManager path.)
billing-admin: Also mention preferred region for dataset (org policy blocks some regions). If you need the dataset in `us-central1` or `europe-west1` call it out. If linking to the billing account, include billing id: `000111-222333-ABCD`.
kai.w: Prefer `us-central1` for both dataset and AMI signing. I filed CLOUD-1755: project=kai-sbx, dataset=dev_billing, k8s ns=ci, ksa=ci-billing-ksa, OIDC issuer=https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com, OIDC subject=repo:team/repo:ref:refs/heads/main, aws acct=666777888999, ssm path=/infra/onboard/kai/amis or SecretsManager secret arn, desired expiry=14d, billing_account=000111-222333-ABCD. Please set minimal perms and time-limited sessions.
infra-bot: Ticket CLOUd-1755 created (typo-corrected to CLOUD-1755) — infra will triage. If you need an extension request before expiry.
security: I added a request for manager approval on KMS/Secrets access. If the secret must be encrypted with a production keyring, please provide justification and retention requirements.
kai.w: thanks everyone! I’ll wait for infra to provision and will update here if they ask for additional CI identity info. Appreciate the help :pray:
